criteria.criterion: After every Copilot session of every phase (plan, gate-review, work, review, second-review, verify, review-brief) the re-judge of T1 runs with that phase's judge (`second-review` judged as the hook judges it, by the review fence), and a denied call that ran halts with exit 9 and `FENCE BYPASSED <phase> — the session ran <n> call(s) its fence denies; nothing from it was used`, preceded by the per-call lines. The halt comes where REFS MOVED halts for that phase: a plan or gate-review halt leaves no plan commit and starts no work; a review or second-review halt commits nothing; a verify halt keeps no reports/verify.json; a review-brief halt prints no verdict and its brief is restored.
criteria.evidence: Result.backstop (fencecheck.go) prints per-call lines then the halt; called in plan.go, gatereview.go, iterate.go (work, reviewRun for review/second-review, verify) and briefreview.go after the brief restore, ahead of the refs guards; cmd/vloop/run_fencebackstop_test.go asserts each phase's effects.

criteria.criterion: Before each Copilot session the driver takes the SHA-256 of the binary the hook runs (the one writeCopilotHooks writes into the hooks file); after it, again. A difference, or the binary gone, halts with exit 9 and `HOOK CHANGED <phase> — the binary the fence hook runs changed during the session: <path>; nothing from it was used`, `<path>` as the hooks file names it, masked. F2 is checked before F1, both as soon as the session ends and before the phase's own checks, so a call that got past the hook and also moved a ref is named before REFS MOVED; the phase's restores (the driver's inputs; a review-brief session's brief) are still made, and a restore that fails is reported after the halt's lines.
criteria.evidence: session.go hashes hookBinaryPath before/after; backstop checks HookChanged before Bypassed; restores run first and restore errors are warned after the halt lines (iterate.go afterSession, briefreview.go); TestBackstopHookChanged.
